articles.title: New guidance for selling tenanted properties
articles.summary: The new guidance is account of the Renters Rights Act
articles.ai_summary:
- New guidance for selling tenanted properties has been introduced in response to the Renters Rights Act.  
- This update aims to clarify the rights and responsibilities of landlords during property sales while tenants remain in residence.

articles.title: Councils fail to collect millions in fines from landlords
articles.summary: The NRLA used Freedom of Information requests to find out
articles.ai_summary:
- Councils across the UK are missing out on millions of pounds in fines owed by landlords, as revealed by the NRLA through Freedom of Information requests.  
- The findings highlight significant gaps in enforcement, raising concerns about the effectiveness of local authorities in managing rental compliance.

articles.title: Rental stock drops as Renters Rights Act kicks in
articles.summary: The total number of homes to rent is now 1% lower than a year ago.
articles.ai_summary:
- Rental stock in the UK has declined by 1% compared to last year as the Renters Rights Act takes effect.  
- The new legislation is impacting the availability of rental properties, highlighting potential challenges for tenants seeking housing.

articles.title: Market stabilises despite new record high rents – Rightmove
articles.summary: Average advertised rents outside London are now 2.3% higher than a year ago
articles.ai_summary:
- Average advertised rents outside London have reached a record high, increasing by 2.3% year-on-year.  
- The UK rental market shows signs of stabilization, despite rising rental prices.

articles.title: New figure leads Housing Ombudsman office – for now
articles.summary: Will the new landlord ombudsman service use this existing social housing service>
articles.ai_summary:
- A new figure has taken the helm at the Housing Ombudsman office, sparking questions about its strategic direction.
- There’s speculation on whether the upcoming landlord ombudsman service will integrate with the existing social housing framework.

articles.title: One in six rental properties sold as landlords quit market
articles.summary: The data comes from respected property consultancy TwentyEA
articles.ai_summary:
- One in six rental properties in the UK has been sold as landlords exit the market, signaling significant changes in the rental landscape.
- The information is based on detailed analysis from the reputable property consultancy, TwentyEA.

articles.title: Remortgaging helps landlords stay afloat in volatile market
articles.summary: This is according to UK Finance, the mortgage lenders' body
articles.ai_summary:
- UK Finance reports that remortgaging is essential for landlords navigating the unpredictable property market.  
- Landlords are leveraging remortgaging to maintain financial stability amid rising interest rates and economic uncertainty.

articles.title: Burnham will bear down on rogue landlords – warning
articles.summary: The new Prime Minister will make enforcement one of his priorities
articles.ai_summary:
- The new Prime Minister plans to prioritize enforcement against rogue landlords in Burnham.  
- A clear warning is issued to landlords about increased scrutiny and potential penalties ahead.

articles.title: Build To Rent massively dearer than mainstream rentals
articles.summary: BTR operators can better absorb higher regulation costs
articles.ai_summary:
- Build to Rent (BTR) properties are significantly more expensive than traditional rentals.  
- BTR operators are better equipped to handle rising regulatory costs, contributing to the price difference.

articles.title: New figure leads Housing Ombudsman office … for now
articles.summary: An interim caretaker Ombudsman has been named
articles.ai_summary:
- An interim caretaker Ombudsman has been appointed to lead the Housing Ombudsman office temporarily.  
- This transition comes as the office seeks a permanent replacement for the previous Ombudsman.

articles.title: Landlords given guidance over extreme weather risks
articles.summary: Apartments and modern houses may present particular hot weather challenges
articles.ai_summary:
- Landlords urged to adapt properties with heat management strategies amid increasing extreme weather risks.
- Modern apartments and houses face specific challenges in mitigating hot weather impacts.

articles.title: Section 21 disproportionately hit black households – claim
articles.summary: The claim comes from Generation Rent
articles.ai_summary:
- Generation Rent asserts that Section 21 evictions disproportionately affect black households in the UK.  
- The findings highlight ongoing concerns about racial disparities within housing policies and their impact on vulnerable communities.

articles.title: Rail boss to head landlord-tenant mediation service
articles.summary: Steve Harriott will retire at Christmas after sixteen years.
articles.ai_summary:
- Steve Harriott, a seasoned rail industry leader, is set to lead a new landlord-tenant mediation service as he retires after 16 years.  
- The initiative aims to improve communication and resolve disputes between landlords and tenants in the UK property market.

articles.title: Shelter claims millions worry over housing costs
articles.summary: It says 40% of workers suffer sleepless nights over housing costs.
articles.ai_summary:
- **Widespread Concern**: Shelter reveals that 40% of workers in the UK are losing sleep over rising housing costs.
- **Housing Crisis Impact**: Millions are reportedly stressed about affordability in the property market, highlighting a growing crisis.

articles.title: Council says selective licensing is ‘win-win’ for landlords and renters
articles.summary: The council is phasing a huge roll out of licensing
articles.ai_summary:
- The council is implementing a comprehensive selective licensing scheme, benefiting both landlords and renters.
- This initiative aims to enhance housing standards and improve tenant security across the area.

articles.title: High-cost areas see biggest exodus of landlords – data
articles.summary: Two areas in particular are seeking the biggest concentration of exiting landlords
articles.ai_summary:
- High-cost regions in the UK are experiencing a significant exodus of landlords, highlighting a trend of retreat from these areas.  
- New data reveals that two specific areas are the focal points for this increase in landlords leaving the market.

articles.title: New platform aims to help landlord compliance
articles.summary: The aim is to remove complexity for landlords, say the creators
articles.ai_summary:
- A new platform has been launched to simplify compliance for landlords in the UK, addressing the challenges they face.  
- Creators emphasize the goal of reducing complexity, making it easier for landlords to navigate regulatory requirements.
